explanation: Only fires at D1 and is 0 at every GO and D2 step: it reaches about 10 at D1 when the previous trial was unrewarded after the agent had been choosing a2, most of all when that a2 choice led to a rare transition to S1 and came after rewarded trials, mostly in trials 5-60. It is weaker (about 2-6) for a second unrewarded trial in a row, for an unrewarded common a2 trial, or occasionally for an unrewarded a1 trial, and 0 at D1 after any rewarded trial and after most unrewarded a1 trials.
